title: App Launcher
slide_intent: Check whether the app can be found among other icons at launcher scale.
strategic_value: The shopping symbol can function as an entry point when it remains recognizable among neighboring marks.
demonstration: A complete phone sits on a pale canvas. Its dark green home screen shows the Instacart icon in a small group of app icons at the top.
practical_value: Inspect the symbol at launcher size rather than judging the enlarged icon alone.

content_islands.name: Page identifier
content_islands.spec: Place App Launcher under the running labels at upper left.

content_islands.name: Launcher specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the entire phone vertically; show the small icons at the top of its home screen with the rest of the field open.
